data.name: BOOSTDRIVE
data.detailed_description:
BOOSTDRIVE is a free-to-play arcade racing game where high-speed cars, neon cityscapes, and Central Asian-inspired cyber environments collide.

Race through stylized urban districts, desert roads, and futuristic tracks designed for fast gameplay, sharp turns, glowing roads, and intense player-versus-player competition. BOOSTDRIVE combines arcade driving, colorful 3D visuals, voxel-inspired world design, and a growing universe of vehicles, characters, and city-based racing experiences.

Key features:

• Fast arcade racing with stylized driving physics

• Single-player and online PvP multiplayer direction

• Cyber-city environments inspired by Central Asian cities

• Neon roads, desert tracks, and futuristic urban districts

• Character and vehicle customization direction

• Free-to-play structure with future cosmetic content and events

BOOSTDRIVE is currently in development. This Steam page is being prepared as a Coming Soon page while we continue building gameplay systems, tracks, vehicles, multiplayer features, and the visual identity of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended requirements may change during development.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during development.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU or better
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during development.
